data.control_account: 1.04.02.04.03.12- CS_SEIT SKDC_A Node Integration, Assembly, Test, & Checkout
data.leadership_messages: WBS definition was incorrect and pointed to STOS systems engineering which is false for this element. The CAM provided the following WBS definition which somehow got lost in handoff between NG and GOV, “This element contains the scope for the integration and testing of C&L configurations in the Command and Launch (C&L) System Integration Lab (CSIL) in support of the INC 1, 2, and 3 test campaigns. It contains the work needed in order to effectively plan, develop test plans and procedures, execute test, and generate test reports for relevant integration and testing at the KDC Node level. It contains the scope for discrete specialty test at the KDC Node level, and KDC site/node integration and sell-off activities.” 2. 28 planned packages under this CA from IFC 3.1 through 6.0. 3. CA is focused on Sentinel SKDC node level (L3) testing activities.
data.rationale: There is moderate confidence that the prime contractor has established mature planning of work packages supporting Sentinel SKDC node level integration and testing. Assessment requires P6 and BOEs to make a thorough and complete evaluation of the CA.

areas.text: Aside from WBS dictionary and definitions having incorrect/outdated information in the artifacts provided to the GOV for review, the NG CAM owner provided an updated WBS definition. The work packages captures the high level program objectives giving confidence in the contractor’s planning maturity and readiness.
Scope is sufficiently captured in work and planning packages to support IIR #2, however, P6 will be required for subsequent review in order to make a complete and full assessment.
Element covers SKDC node level 3 test activities.
